preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer T, and the total number of lines is 1 + 2*T, matching the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 10**5 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S) for S in [stdin_lines[i] for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string S consists only of lowercase English letters and has a length between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= len(S) for S, K in zip([stdin_lines[i] for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)], [int(stdin_lines[i+1]) for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the integer K satisfies 1 <= K <= length of S.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(out) == K for out, K in zip(stdout_lines, [int(stdin_lines[i+1]) for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)]))
postconditions.description: Each output line has length exactly K for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(is_subsequence(out, S) for out, S in zip(stdout_lines, [stdin_lines[i] for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)]))
postconditions.description: Each output string is a valid subsequence of the corresponding input string S.

postconditions.expression: all(out <= other for out, S, K in zip(stdout_lines, [stdin_lines[i] for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)], [int(stdin_lines[i+1]) for i in range(1, len(stdin_lines), 2)]) for other in get_all_subsequences(S, K))
postconditions.description: Each output string is lexicographically smaller than or equal to every other subsequence of S of length K.
